```text
Emit a v3 generation manifest (closure store paths on stdin)

Usage: kasha emit [OPTIONS] --flake <FLAKE> --gen <GEN_ID> --branch <BRANCH> --attr <ATTR>

Options:
      --flake <FLAKE>          Flake id the manifest is filed under (roots/<flake>/)
      --gen <GEN_ID>           Generation id; names the manifest object (roots/<flake>/<gen>.json)
      --branch <BRANCH>        Source branch; `main` selects the main retention tier, anything else the other tier
      --attr <ATTR>            Built attribute; generations are retained per (flake, branch, attr) group
      --timestamp <TIMESTAMP>  ISO-8601 UTC; defaults to now
      --to <TO>                Publish target: s3://bucket?endpoint=… (AWS_* creds) or an http(s):// box URL (KASHA_TOKEN). Prints to stdout either way
  -h, --help                   Print help
```
